jobDescription: Ormsby Facilities maintains heating, ventilation and electrical systems for schools and council buildings. The Field Service Operations Coordinator schedules engineers against contract deadlines, administers the job-dispatch system, introduces system changes into live operation with a documented cut-over plan, supports engineers and controllers through the first live weeks and reports performance to the contracts manager. Around 120 engineers cover about 900 sites, the control room works from 7 am to 8 pm on weekdays with an out-of-hours desk, and the coordinator works with the operations manager, the IT team and the contracts manager.
requirements: Schedules field engineers against service-level deadlines.
Administers the job-dispatch or field-service management system.
Has introduced a system change into live operation with a documented cut-over and supported users through the first live weeks.
Trains engineers and controllers on new processes.
Reports first-time-fix and attendance performance to the contracts manager.

evidence.text: Service Controller, Pellow Mechanical Services, January 2021 to September 2024. Scheduled 85 field engineers across two regions against four-hour and next-day attendance deadlines, using the scheduling board in the field-service management system.
Administered user accounts, job types and the skills matrix in the field-service management system, and kept the engineer skills list aligned with training records.

Moved all 85 engineers from paper job sheets to the mobile job-dispatch app at the April 2024 cut-over, working to the cut-over plan the operations manager had approved, with paper job sheets kept as a fallback for one week.
Ran 12 training sessions on the mobile app for engineers and controllers, using a test copy of the dispatch system loaded with dummy jobs, ending each session with a short quiz.
Compiled a monthly attendance report against contract deadlines for the contracts manager, broken down by building type and region.

Work sample: the cut-over plan for the job-dispatch app, setting out the weekend timeline for 13 and 14 April 2024, data-migration checks, rollback criteria and the operations manager's approval signature, plus a contact list for the weekend.

Reference check summary: Pellow's operations manager confirmed in writing that the candidate ran the cut-over weekend on 13 and 14 April 2024 and staffed the floor-walker desk for engineers' app queries during the first two live weeks.
HR verification note: the employment dates January 2021 to September 2024 and the title Service Controller were checked against Pellow's written employment reference.

propositions.text: The candidate moved 85 engineers from paper job sheets to the mobile job-dispatch app at the April 2024 cut-over under an approved cut-over plan.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the cut-over and the work sample is the approved plan with its dates and rollback criteria.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the cut-over weekend and staffed the floor-walker desk for engineers' app queries during the first two live weeks.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the operations manager's written confirmation.

propositions.text: The candidate scheduled 85 field engineers across two regions against attendance deadlines.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the scheduling work directly.

gold.expectedGap: The monthly attendance report is documented; first-time-fix reporting is not.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the cut-over with its approved plan and dates and the verified floor-walker support; keep the training as sessions run on a test copy of the system.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate reported first-time-fix rates to the contracts manager and how they were measured.
